title: Meta lays off co-founders, employees of AI safety startup 4 months after hiring them
source_used: Moneycontrol (full text, a re-run of Semafor's report) and the original Semafor exclusive of 2 Oct 2026 (full text)
key_facts: Semafor reported on 2 Oct 2026 (exclusive) that Meta is letting go of employees it hired from the AI safety startup Virtue AI four months after they joined in June; Meta spokesperson Andy Stone put it down to clashing work styles.
Stone said the arrangement 'didn't work out as planned' and that Meta Superintelligence Labs remains focused on AI safety, alignment and frontier risk.

Virtue AI, an AI security and governance startup, had worked with Anthropic, OpenAI and the Commerce Department's NIST; its products included automated red-teaming, runtime guardrails and governance tools (Moneycontrol).
Meta recruited a dedicated team from Virtue AI rather than buying the company (Moneycontrol).

Semafor says only that Axios reported in June that Virtue AI co-founders Bo Li, Dawn Song and Sanmi Koyejo were joining Meta with other employees, and that the team did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
Moneycontrol's 5 Oct 2026 version says the outgoing team includes those three co-founders; Semafor's original does not say they are among those let go.
Moneycontrol also repeats unverified social media posts, including a claim that OpenAI fired its contact for METR and Redwood this week; these were not used.
We carried the Semafor story in our 3 Oct 2026 edition (item 19).
quote_evidence: Meta said it’s letting go of employees it hired from AI safety startup Virtue AI four months after they joined the company in June, Meta spokesperson Andy Stone told Semafor, chalking it up to clashing work styles.
Axios reported in June that Virtue AI co-founders Bo Li, Dawn Song, and Sanmi Koyejo were joining Meta along with other employees from the startup.
Meta spokesperson Andy Stone told Semafor that the company was letting go of the Virtue AI hires because “the arrangement didn’t work out as planned.”
why_it_matters_hint: A small staffing story that Meta confirmed on the record; nothing new has been verified since 2 Oct 2026.
event_date: Semafor exclusive 2 Oct 2026; Moneycontrol re-run 5 Oct 2026
notes: Old news re-dated into the window: Semafor broke it on 2 Oct 2026 and we carried it on 3 Oct 2026 (item 19, source Semafor); likely to be held back as a re-dated duplicate. Moneycontrol's headline and text say the co-founders are among those let go, which Semafor's original does not say and our 3 Oct entry correctly left open. Score lowered by 2 for staleness and the unsupported addition.
